title: Align the Purity signature and body comments
recommendation: The signature comment and the three comments in the body share a column. Accept the one-column shift from the source because the longest code line has the standard two-space gap.

title: Keep forM generators on separate lines
recommendation: The formatter preserves the three generator lines and the short yield expression. The only byte difference is the final newline. A fixture also checks the compact layout at a wider line width.

title: Lay out the entire else-if chain together
recommendation: When the chain has to break, give each branch the same layout. The current output puts the first result on its own line but combines the remaining branches.

title: Keep the HTTP middleware layout
recommendation: Each with starts on a separate line and the match arrows share a column. Retain this layout. Flix 0.80.0 reported unresolved names in both standalone versions.

title: Update the website's purity reflection example
recommendation: Flix 0.80.0 rejects the displayed syntax. Update the example to use match purityOf(f), as the book does.

title: Check the Java example's unsafe syntax
recommendation: Flix 0.80.0 reports a parse error on the original. Update the example for the documented compiler version and verify it as a complete snippet.

title: Present the Logger signatures as an excerpt
